slides.title: CAPL Exercise
slides.body:
The scope of this exercise is to simulate a part of the environment that
communicates with IPC ECU.
1. Create a CANoe/CANalyzer configuration and add the
P332BEV_BH-CAN_R1_20200902_E2A_plus_CR14698-14830-14888.dbc
you can find in the folder (see CANalyzer/CANoe lessons).
2. Insert a Program/Network node and write a CAPL that is able to:
● Send for the entire measurement duration, with the period you can find in
the .dbc, STATUS_UBSS_BH message;
● Send TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP2 message with PowerLevelReq signal
value equal to 0x3 when “2” key is pressed;
● Increase a counter Count1 each time PowerLevel signal in IPC_
VEHICLE_SETUP message is NOT equal to PowerLevelReq, when IPC_
VEHICLE_SETUP is received;
● Decrease Count1 each time PowerLevel signal in IPC_ VEHICLE_SETUP
message is equal to PowerLevelReq, when IPC_ VEHICLE_SETUP is
received (the counter can not assume negative values);
● Stop sending STATUS_UBSS_BH if Bus Off condition occurs;
● Print on the Write window the sentence “PowerLevel signal value has been
different from PowerLevelReq one … times” (replace … with Count1 value)
at the end of the measurement.
